title: LEFT JOIN finds what's missing
why_it_matters: 'Which users have no orders?' is a very common question.
explanation: A left join keeps every row from the left table, even without a match. The right side's columns become null. Filtering for null on the right table gives you exactly the rows with no matches, like unpaid bookings.
code:
select b.guest_name
from bookings b
left join payments p on p.booking_id = b.id
where p.id is null;
try_it: Find users who have never posted anything.
